channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Russell Crowe Netflix 2026 thriller ‘Unabomber’ hits 40 million views despite mixed reviews
item.description: Russell Crowe’s Netflix crime thriller Unabomber has reportedly drawn around 40 million views in its first two weeks, emerging as one of the platform’s biggest hits of 2026 despite a poor critical reception. The film stars Jacob Tremblay as Ted Kaczynski.

item.title: Riyadh airport attacked again: Trump weighs joining Saudi strikes on Houthis
item.description: The latest attack came amid an escalation in hostilities between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis.

item.title: Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan's execution set for December 3: What we know about the livestream row
item.description: Hasan, a former US Army psychiatrist, was sentenced to death in 2013 for killing 13 people and injuring 32 others in a shooting at the Fort Hood military base in Texas in 2009. His execution is scheduled for December 3.

item.title: CJP Protests Day 1: 7000 detained including four ex-CMs, metro shutdowns and CJI’s intervention; how it unfolded
item.description: Delhi Police detained over 7,000 protesters opposing alleged electoral roll malpractices by CEC Gyanesh Kumar, with CJP leaders and Opposition figures among those held. The crackdown triggered criticism from Congress and other parties, while the BJP accused protesters of trying to destabilise India.

item.title: India hits back at UN Human Rights office over remarks on Delhi protest detentions, calls concerns ‘misplaced’
item.description: India also urged the UN Human Rights office to devote comparable attention to large-scale protests in other parts of the world, citing the need for impartiality and non-selectivity in its work.

item.title: ‘Get a new leader’: Trump targets Zelensky after Ukraine president objects to diesel deal with Putin
item.description: Trump also warned Zelensky to stop targeting Russian oil refineries, suggesting that the strikes had contributed to rising diesel prices ahead of the US midterm elections on November 3.

item.title: CJP calls for fresh protests at Jantar Mantar on Sunday, 11 Oct; traffic curbs at 30 key points in Delhi: All we know
item.description: The CJP has called for fresh protests tomorrow after Delhi Police clamped down on protestors doing towards Jantar Mantar on Saturday, detaining more than 7,000 individuals.

item.title: Delhi protests tomorrow: What is open and what is closed on Sunday, 11 October; traffic restrictions and more
item.description: Delhi faces possible travel disruption on Sunday, 11 October, as the Cockroach Janta Party plans protests despite police denying permission.&nbsp;

item.title: Delhi Metro update: DMRC says entry and exit of all stations now open amid protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
item.description: Delhi Metro restored entry, exit and interchange facilities at all stations on Saturday after imposing temporary restrictions amid the CJP protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. The protest, over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls, saw several opposition leaders and activists detained.

item.title: Saudi airport attacked again: Missile strike reported, many wounded; passengers evacuated, flights diverted
item.description: There was no immediate statement from the Houthis claiming responsibility for Saturday’s incident.

item.title: Earthquake Today: 4.2-magnitude quake hits Uttarkashi, second tremor above 4 in Uttarakhand in four days
item.description: A 4.2-magnitude earthquake struck Uttarkashi in Uttarakhand on Saturday night, triggering panic as residents rushed outdoors. No damage reported so far.

item.title: Centre brings about major bureaucratic reshuffle: Prakash Rajpurohit made Dy Election Commissioner | Check complete list
item.description: The Centre appointed 2010-batch IAS officer Prakash Rajpurohit as Deputy Election Commissioner until April 8, 2030. Vivek Khare was named Joint Secretary at NTA as part of a wider reshuffle in which the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet cleared 27 civil servants for senior posts.

item.title: UN Human Rights body expresses concern over detentions during Delhi, Mumbai protests; calls for release of detainees
item.description: The UN Human Rights office urged Indian authorities to ensure that law enforcement personnel exercised “utmost restraint” in responding to peaceful protesters, in keeping with India's democratic traditions and human rights obligations.

item.title: Putin informs Trump Iran's position on peace deal, reports Kremlin; what has Tehran proposed?
item.description: The Kremlin did not disclose the details of Iran’s position or say how Trump responded to the message. It also did not provide further information on the possible terms of a settlement.

item.title: What is a preventative detention? How is it different from arrest? What to know amid police crackdown in Delhi protests
item.description: Delhi Police detained more than 7,000 protesters as they tried reaching Jantar Mantar for the planned protest by CJP against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Understand what powers do police have to detain protesters, and what safeguards apply.

item.title: Meet Rakesh Kumar: Indian Oil executive recommended for CPCL’s Director of Operations post
item.description: Rakesh Kumar, currently General Manager of Technical Services at IOCL, was selected from nine candidates for CPCL’s board-level Director of Operations role. The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet must approve the recommendation before he can take charge.

item.title: CJP July protest’s internet-famous faces are back together: What their ‘Season 2’ video shows amid CEC stir in Delhi
item.description: A new video reunites viral faces Abhinav Bisht, Muhammad Shan and Nikhil Verma amid the protest agsinst CEC Gyanesh Kumar. The clip recalls the group’s July protests over the NEET-UG paper leak. However, Delhi Police denied permission for the gathering. The day saw detentions of over 7000 people.

item.title: CJP protests: Supreme Court to hold special Sunday sitting on contempt plea over Delhi Metro shutdowns during protests
item.description: The Supreme Court will hear a contempt petition on Sunday over the closure of 45 Delhi Metro stations and cancelled train services during an anti-Chief Election Commissioner protest.

item.title: Panama earthquake: Is the tsunami warning still in place? Have aftershocks been detected? Here's what we know so far
item.description: The earthquake's epicentre was near Pitaloza Arriba in central Herrera province, at a shallow depth of around 10 km. Damage was reported across Herrera, Coclé, Los Santos and Veraguas.

item.title: Protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar: Imran Khan detained in Mumbai; Prakash Raj says 'Frands how long will you stop river'
item.description: Several Bollywood personalities, including Imran Khan, Prakash Raj, Anurag Kashyap and Vishal Dadlani, reacted to the October 10 anti-CEC protests. While Khan was detained in Mumbai, others criticised police action as demonstrations against electoral roll revisions intensified.

item.title: CJP protests: Why were the Supreme Court lawyers released by Delhi Police? Here's what CJI Surya Kant said
item.description: CJI Surya Kant said his intervention helped secure the release of advocates detained by Delhi Police during peaceful protests near the Supreme Court. The detentions prompted urgent appeals from lawyers’ associations, which also sought confirmation of detainees’ safety and access to legal assistance.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi meets Vijay in Chennai: Political talks, cappuccino and tiramisu — here's what was on the menu
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is currently in Chennai for the Chhatron Ki Goonj event. Ahead of his scheduled event, LoP met CM Vijay in the city.

item.title: Pennsylvania shooting: 9 killed in Erie mass shooting, including children; suspected gunman found dead
item.description: As per a report, police responded to a home on Perry Street in Erie at around 5 pm on Friday after witnesses reported seeing a gunman firing shots outside the house before entering the residence.

item.title: Social Security $90 checks: Why Trump is sending extra money to millions of seniors
item.description: The administration's payment announcements come against a backdrop of voter concerns about affordability and the president's handling of the economy.

item.title: Delhi commuters alert! DMRC says 45 metro stations to remain closed till 10 pm today amid CJP's protest against CEC
item.description: DMRC said 45 metro stations closed since Friday night over security concerns will remain shut until 10 pm on October 10 amid the CJP protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter-roll irregularities.&nbsp;

item.title: Can Gyanesh Kumar be prosecuted? Explaining Section 16 of CEC Act as CJP, Oppn allege CEC took unilateral decisions
item.description: The Supreme Court questioned whether a 2023 law gives the Chief Election Commissioner and other election commissioners greater legal protection than constitutional court judges. The case concerns alleged unilateral decisions by CEC Gyanesh Kumar during electoral-roll revisions.

item.title: ‘What are you so scared of?’ Opposition reacts as 3 former CMs get detained in Delhi
item.description: Protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar led to around 1,000 detentions in Delhi. Former chief ministers Pinarayi Vijayan, Arvind Kejriwal and Mamata Banerjee were detained.&nbsp;

item.title: Did Delhi authorities dump garbage to disrupt Jantar Mantar protests? PIB fact checks viral claim
item.description: A video of trucks dumping garbage on the streets has gone viral across social media, calling it an attempt to stop protestors from reaching Jantar Mantar. Reacting to it, PIB has called it ‘fake.’

item.title: ‘Undeclared emergency’: Sonam Wangchuk warns of fast, march if leaders detained in Delhi not released by tomorrow
item.description: Activist Sonam Wangchuk called the situation in India an ‘undeclared emergency’ after political leaders and activists were detained in Delhi ahead of a protest demanding chief election commissioner's resignation. He said he may begin an indefinite fast or march if they are not released by Sunday.

item.title: CJI Surya Kant flags digital stigma for children in conflict with law, calls for timely destruction of records | Video
item.description: At a consultation marking ten years of the Juvenile Justice Act, Chief Justice Surya Kant warned that lasting digital stigma can harm children in conflict with the law. He called for old records to be destroyed on time and for children’s identities to remain private.

item.title: Who is Neha Bora? Meet the fiesty Gen Z AISA president protesting against CEC Gyanesh Kumar in Delhi
item.description: AISA president Neha Bora was detained near Delhi’s INA market after marching toward Dilli Haat during a CJP protest demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged voter-roll irregularities. She urged supporters to continue gathering at Safdarjung Flyover, saying the movement would go on.

item.title: NIA invokes Anti-Hijacking Act in Flydubai cockpit attack on Captain Smit Machchhar, to probe terror angle
item.description: The FlyDubai flight FZ1073, was diverted and made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, following an attack on Indian Captain Smit Machchhar.&nbsp;

item.title: ED arrests Sadhna Group MD over money-laundering allegations: Who is Rakesh Gupta? What’s the ₹168 crore case?
item.description: Sadhna Group founder Rakesh Gupta has been arrested in an ED money-laundering case. Investigators allege that about ₹168 crore in proceeds are involved.

item.title: Delhi Protest: Will CJP call off demonstrations if CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns? Here's what we know
item.description: CJP co-convenor Saurav Das says Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation alone will not end the agitation. The group also seeks a freeze on SIR, an independent inquiry, and electoral reforms. Its Delhi protest faced heavy security restrictions, with leaders, activists, and hundreds detained ahead of the rally.

item.title: Delhi Protest: ‘Dilli Haat becomes our Jantar Mantar,’ says AISA activist Neha Bora amid police detention, crackdown
item.description: Delhi Protest: AISA activist Neha Bora statement came after the police crackdown on protesters, lawyers and journalists around Jantar Mantar on Saturday, October 10.
